changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: For finance owners (CFOs, controllers): "Know where every deposit is, and see each one matched to its transactions and invoices." Lead with this. Move M1 to a later slide.
changes.why: Our opener drew silence and the CFO only engaged when the reconciliation demo showed her own deposits, and she said "I just want to know where my money is" rather than using any infrastructure language.

changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: "We'll calculate your cost of manual deposit matching from your own statements, and show the method so you can check every input." Use this as a standard ROI session, not a published figure.
changes.why: The CFO asked to see the analysis on her own data, and her reply "that's my number, not yours" shows that a generic study does not persuade, while the rep could not reproduce the figure that closed the deal.

changes.current_line: Built for developers: launch payments fast with our APIs, docs and sandbox.
changes.change: Stop leading with developer messaging for finance buyers in B2B deals. Use it only when a technical buyer is the decider.
changes.why: The decider was the finance owner, who never said "payments" and signed on a close and deposit-matching problem, while the developer-first message had no role in the decision.

changes.change: For wholesale and distribution buyers: "A wholesale distributor reference, with a reference call booked before the proposal." Do not send retail case studies to B2B distributors.
changes.why: The CFO asked for a distributor reference and dismissed the retail case study we sent instead, and the reference call was never delivered, so a matching proof point is missing from our messaging.
